international.title: MP Helen Haines leaves hospital four weeks after alleged attack and double leg amputation
international.summary: Independent MP says she is ‘overwhelmed’ by thousands of warm wishes and thanked Australians for donations Independent Australian MP Helen Haines has been discharged from hospital, four weeks after she was allegedly attacked by a man outside her electorate office in regional Victoria resulting in the double amputation of her legs. In a statement, Haines said she has moved to the rehabilitation stage of her recovery, which would continue in Melbourne. Haines was being treated at the city’s Alfred Hospital which confirmed her discharge on Monday. Continue reading...
